decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify"><span style="color: rgb(11, 118, 159);">Notwithstanding the approved plans,
which show the use of Marshalls Drivesett Tegula Priora block paving in a
Harvest colour finish, this element of the proposal is not approved and the
existing/proposed bound gravel surfacing shall be retained. The materials to be
used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby
permitted shall otherwise accord with the approved Schedule of Materials. The
development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and
shall thereafter be retained as such.<i><o:p></o:p></i></span></p>
